action.startBlocked: The state of this container cannot be queried right now — starting it would be flying blind.
footer.budgetOnly: There are no measurements for the host's CPU and RAM — the bars show the configured budget, not the real utilisation.
idle.countingHint: Without players it is stopped after {{days}} days. "At the earliest" because the round only runs every {{interval}} minutes — and because it asks live once more beforehand: if the server does not answer, it is NOT stopped.
idle.dueHint: The deadline has passed. The next round asks live for players and only stops when demonstrably nobody is there.
idle.graceHint: Freshly started: it is not stopped during the first hour, so that someone can join.
idle.neverSeenHint: The server was seen for the first time — the next round starts the clock.
idle.noTimeoutHint: No timeout set — the server stays on.
idle.notRunningHint: A stopped server is not stopped.
idle.offHint: The idle stop is switched off for this server.
idle.playersOnlineHint: As long as someone is playing, the clock is reset on every round.
off.hint: Not on the fleet list: new servers until their container exists and they are enabled, and servers taken out of service.
off.title: Switched off
players.unknownHint: The server is not answering the player query right now. That does NOT mean nobody is there.
subtitle: All servers at a glance — with the buttons right next to them
